card_title.en: Carvit makes AI code fixes provable
card_title.ko: Carvit은 AI 코드 수정을 증명 가능하게 만듭니다

summary.en: Passing the checks was not enough once an AI fixed code. On the duplicate-function target, Solar-pro4 passed lint 4 times out of 4 before the guard and still changed behavior. After it, both models went from 0/4 to 4/4. Measured on Upstage Solar-pro4 and Llama 3.3 70B.
summary.ko: AI가 코드를 고쳤을 때 검사를 통과했다는 것만으로는 부족했습니다. 중복 함수 대상에서 Solar-pro4는 안전장치 전에 4번 중 4번 린트를 통과하고도 동작이 바뀌었고, 장치를 더하자 두 모델 모두 0/4에서 4/4가 되었습니다. Upstage Solar-pro4와 Llama 3.3 70B로 잰 결과입니다.

card_title.en: Passing review did not mean ready to launch

summary.en: Two AI agents built self-service onboarding, from sign-up to the first screen, in about nine and a half hours with no human QA (51 merged PRs). Review passed, but test agents that knew nothing about it found two defects that appeared only against the real server.
summary.ko: 사람 QA 없이 AI 에이전트 둘이 약 9시간 반 동안 가입부터 첫 화면까지의 온보딩을 만들었습니다(병합 PR 51개). 리뷰는 통과했지만, 배경지식 없는 시험 에이전트가 실제 서버를 부를 때만 나오는 결함 2건을 출시 전에 찾았습니다.

summary.en: How an AI can use your keys without ever seeing them. We wrote down what the vault protects and what it does not, how its keys are layered, and which threats we answered and which we could not.

card_title.en: How we chose the Carvit logo

summary.en: We chose the mark by measuring, not by taste: research before drawing, four first candidates rejected, a map of 40 real logos, two expert reviews, and the numbers that changed the mark.
